title: Python developer with Web3
description:
We are seeking a skilled Python Developer with a strong understanding of Web3 and cryptocurrency technologies. You will build and optimize blockchain-based applications, smart contract integrations, and decentralized solutions while ensuring high performance and security.
Responsibilities:
- Develop and maintain Web3-powered backend systems and APIs.
- Integrate cryptocurrency wallets, smart contracts, and blockchain protocols.
- Optimize performance and scalability for decentralized applications (dApps).
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement secure and efficient solutions.
- Stay updated on blockchain trends and technologies.
- Rust would be a plus
